last.verdict: Palantir's growth is still accelerating, with US business customers now bigger than the US government, but new business contracts are getting smaller and shorter.

takeaways.label: Blowout quarter, raised outlook
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 96% to $2.31B against roughly $2.18B expected. Full-year revenue guidance rose to about $8.53B, with Q4 guided to about $2.65B.

takeaways.label: Business customers overtake government
takeaways.text: US commercial revenue grew 148% to $984M, passing US government revenue ($953M) for the first time. Full-year US commercial guidance is now above $3.56B.

takeaways.label: Bookings and contract length lag
takeaways.text: US commercial new-contract value was $1.46B, down from a record $2.13B last quarter. Management says deals now start shorter and expand later, with duration and size expected to grow.

takeaways.label: Profits remain extreme
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating margin was 62% and free cash flow was $1.22B. Management says the AI-driven 'Sovereign AI' demand trend is only about a quarter old, so durability is unproven.

history.verdict: Record growth and a huge forecast raise crushed expectations, sending shares soaring.

reasons.label: Biggest guidance raise ever
reasons.text: 2026 revenue outlook lifted to about $8.15B from $7.65B, well above Wall Street's view.

reasons.label: Revenue beat by wide margin
reasons.text: Revenue rose 93% to $1.94B versus roughly $1.81B expected; U.S. business grew 149%.

reasons.label: Record deals, high profits
reasons.text: U.S. commercial deal bookings hit $2.13B, up 153%, with a 62% adjusted operating margin.
